case.narrative: 3 times in the last 4 weeks, I have had a situation where I get into the car to drive it and the Infotainment screen is black and not functional.  The only way to reset it is to get out, lock the car, and come back 15 minutes later and it resolves itself.  During the time the Infotainment screen is not functioning, the car is still drivable, but if you put it into reverse the backup camera is not shown on the infotainment screen, nor are any other of the assistive/safety features involved with parking or safely backing up the vehicle.  I've taken the car into VW Service and it came back "unable to reproduce" and "no trouble found", and they provided no assistance in how to quickly restore functionality of the infotainment screen, including use of the safety NHSTA-mandated backup camera.  This is a safety hazard, as the car is still drivable and it's likely people who have this problem will still drive the car even though mandated safety features like the backup camera are inoperative.

decision.rationale: Safety flag stands; the case keeps priority for a live engineer.
